title: Phantasy Star Portable 2
subtitle: A new mercenary joins Little Wing

body: Phantasy Star Portable 2 is Alfa System's PSP action role-playing game, first released in Japan on 3 December 2009. The player creates a character who joins Little Wing, a private mercenary group based on the Clad 6 resort colony. Set three years after the earlier Portable adventure, the story follows a society facing depleted resources and plans for migration. Missions provide the immediate work of the mercenary career, while the character's appearance and development make the resulting adventurer personal. The series' science-fiction equipment and fantasy combat continue within a structure suited to portable play.

Photon Points are attached to the character rather than individual weapons, changing how the resource is managed across available equipment. Guarding, evasive movement and offensive abilities give the player several ways to respond during real-time encounters. Character creation includes appearance and voice choices before that combat career begins. Equipment and development remain reasons to repeat missions, as a successful expedition can improve the options brought to the next one. The connection between the created character and the available fighting tools becomes the continuity running through the changing assignments and enemies.

Single-player missions coexist with multiplayer, allowing the same broad action role-playing structure to become a shared expedition. Yuya Kimura directed the game, with a score including Hideaki Kobayashi, Fumie Kumatani and Kenichi Tokoi. International editions followed in September 2010. The sequel develops the earlier Portable format through its revised resource system and expanded action choices while retaining the appeal of a customised adventurer gathering equipment with others. Its place in Phantasy Star's history comes from carrying that cooperative mission-and-growth rhythm onto PSP without reducing the player's character to a fixed hero.
